requirement: Describe the study as a prospective single-center randomized three-arm parallel trial in active-duty service members with subacute low back pain, comparing two home-managed active regimens plus primary care with primary care alone over nine weeks.

evidence.text: This study is a randomized clinical trial with repeated measures over time ... All groups will have an intensive 9-week program.
We will draw upon Active Duty members and Reserve/National Guard members on active duty status through ... BACH.

requirement: Define the three randomized groups as NMES core-strength training plus PCM, progressive exercise plan plus PCM, and PCM alone, with randomization occurring only after the pretreatment assessment.

evidence.text: Participants will be randomly assigned to 1) NMES core strength training plus PCM, 2) PEP plus PCM and 3) standard primary care management (PCM). We will not randomize participants until after the pre-treatment assessment has been completed.

requirement: Use baseline and Weeks 3, 6, and 9 as the four repeated-measure assessment times.

evidence.text: Participants will be ... assessed again at 3, 6 and 9 weeks.
The study will use a repeated measure design with measures at 4 time points.

requirement: Define the target population as active-duty adults aged 18 to under 45 years whose current low-back-pain episode has lasted more than 3 weeks and less than 12 weeks.
acceptable_values: low back pain more than 3 weeks and less than 12 weeks

evidence.text: Active Duty at time of diagnosis ... LBP greater than 3 weeks and less than 12 weeks ... age >=18 and <45 years.

requirement: Include maximal isometric torso-flexion and torso-extension strength as primary-family outcomes, using the highest kilogram value from two five-second efforts separated by 30 seconds.

evidence.text: The primary measures ... are lower back muscle strength ... two maximal efforts maintaining each ... for 5 seconds, separated by 30-second rest; the highest value of the two trials will be accepted in kilograms.

requirement: Include the mobility and functional-performance outcomes: two-minute push-up count, two-minute sit-up count, lumbar-trunk-muscle endurance time, and six-minute-walk distance.

evidence.text: Mobility will be measured by these procedures: 2-minute push-up test, 2-minute sit-up test, lumbar trunk muscle test and a 6-minute walk test.

requirement: Include Fitbit-derived daily steps and energy expenditure as physical-activity outcomes during the nine-week intervention.

evidence.text: Physical activity will be measured using the Fitbit Charge 2 ... measures steps walked ... energy expenditure ... the device will be worn daily for 9 weeks.

requirement: Include low-back-pain symptoms and disability measured with the Clinical Back Pain Questionnaire, Oswestry Disability Index, and activity-specific 0-to-10 visual analogue pain scales.

evidence.text: Pain ... will be measured by the Clinical Back Pain Questionnaire ... LBP-related disability ... by the Oswestry Disability Index ... The Visual Analog Scale ... 0.0 cm ... 10 cm.

requirement: Include health-related quality of life from SF-12v2 physical and mental summary scores and depressive symptoms from the 20-item CES-D.

evidence.text: The SF-12v2 Health Survey ... has two summary scores for physical and mental health ... depressive symptoms will be measured by the Centers for Epidemiologic Studies Depression instrument ... 20 items.

requirement: Use the prospective protocol target of 135 participants, 45 per group, and do not substitute the later registry actual enrollment of 133.

evidence.text: To obtain a sample size of 135 adults with subacute LBP (45 per group) ...

notes: The generation input is the prospective protocol; actual enrollment is execution information and is not a replacement for the planned sample size.

requirement: Derive intervention adherence as reported home sessions divided by prescribed sessions and assess NMES adherence using both the stimulator's internal usage timer and participant training logs.
acceptable_values: completed sessions divided by prescribed sessions

evidence.text: Compliance/adherence ... will be computed as the number of home sessions reported ... divided by the total number of sessions prescribed ... hidden internal compliance timer ... compared to the training logs.

requirement: Summarize continuous variables with means and standard deviations, supplementing with medians where appropriate, and summarize categorical variables with percentages.

evidence.text: Means and standard deviations will be calculated for continuous variables and percentages for categorical variables.

requirement: Assess baseline group differences with ANOVA for continuous characteristics and chi-square tests for categorical characteristics, and adjust for material group imbalances as covariates.

evidence.text: ANOVA and chi-square will be used to test for differences in baseline characteristics ... Group inequities will be controlled ... by using covariates.

notes: Expert review should consider whether standardized differences are preferable to significance tests for baseline balance.

requirement: Fit a separate longitudinal linear mixed-effects model for each outcome, with fixed effects for time, treatment group, and treatment-by-time interaction and adjustment for prespecified important covariates.

evidence.text: Longitudinal mixed regression models ... primary measures will be expressed as a function of time, treatment group, and group-by-time interactions, while controlling for important covariates.

requirement: For each Aim I outcome, use linear contrasts to compare the rate of change for NMES plus PCM versus PCM alone and PEP plus PCM versus PCM alone.

evidence.text: We will construct linear contrasts to compare the rate of change in each treatment group with the rate of change in the usual care group.

requirement: For Aim II quality-of-life, disability, and low-back-pain symptom models, include treatment group, time, and treatment-by-time interaction and adjust for pain medication.

evidence.text: We will estimate separate equations for QOL, disability and LBP symptom dependent variables ... treatment group, time, and group-by-time interaction. We will adjust for pain medication.

requirement: Use an intention-to-treat analysis that retains all randomized participants under their original group assignment and fits the mixed model to the repeated observations actually collected.

evidence.text: All of the subjects in the study will be included ... data actually collected. Treatment effects will be compared on the basis of the subject's original group assignment.

notes: The SAP does not explain how participants with no post-baseline data can contribute to the mixed model; this must be resolved during expert review.

requirement: Before finalization, designate the confirmatory outcome or outcome hierarchy and define its treatment effect, summary measure, and primary assessment-time contrast; the protocol lists multiple primary measures but no single success-defining estimand.

evidence.text: The primary outcome measures are lower back muscle strength, activity, and mobility, followed by multiple component measures, without a confirmatory hierarchy or primary time contrast.

requirement: Before finalization, specify the mixed-model time parameterization, participant-level random effects, within-participant covariance structure, estimation method, degrees-of-freedom method, diagnostics, and convergence fallback.

evidence.text: A linear mixed effects model will be used ... The two-page plan does not specify time coding, random effects, covariance, estimation, degrees of freedom or fallback rules.

requirement: Before finalization, define the two-sided alpha, effect-estimate and confidence-interval reporting, and multiplicity control or an explicitly exploratory interpretation across the two active-control contrasts, many outcomes, and repeated times.

evidence.text: The protocol defines three groups, four visits and numerous primary and secondary measures but delegates statistical methods and states no alpha or multiplicity rule.
The SAP proposes separate models and contrasts for many outcomes but gives no alpha, confidence-interval or multiplicity procedure.

requirement: Before finalization, state the missing-data assumption, rules for partially observed outcome components and participants without post-baseline data, and at least one sensitivity analysis for departures from the primary assumption.

evidence.text: Missing data rates and patterns will be assessed ... the mixed effects model deals with missingness ... The plan does not state an assumption, component rules or a sensitivity analysis.

requirement: Before finalization, define the safety population, treatment-emergent adverse-event window, event coding and group summaries for adverse events related to NMES, exercise, and usual-care medication.

evidence.text: The protocol describes NMES, progressive exercise, medication and safety-related exclusions, but neither the protocol nor the two-page SAP defines an adverse-event analysis.
